3. Now I have 4 dark oak planks.

5. Craft 4 stick using 2 planks.
6. Now I have 4 sticks.
7. Craft 1 crafting table using 4 planks.
8. Now I have 1 crafting table.

2. Craft 4 dark oak planks using 1 dark oak log.
